Rural apartments with a kitchen in El Bedorc, near Montserrat

Two self-contained apartments at La Casa Vella, an 1898 village house in El Bedorc (Piera): Montserrat and La Pineda, for up to 3 guests, with a fitted kitchen and private bathroom, 15 minutes from the Sant Sadurní cava cellars.

La Casa Vella has two apartments, each with its own kitchen, for guests who want to stay a few days and keep their own rhythm. They keep the house's wooden beams, painted green, with antique furniture and handmade details.

Both have air conditioning and heating, free wifi, a smart TV and fridge, towels and bed linen, and free parking. The house is in El Bedorc, a hamlet of Piera among vineyards: Sant Sadurní d'Anoia is a 15-minute drive and Montserrat 45.
